originalSubject: Re: Hashtag Web3: publisher onboarding and automatic news-feed distribution

payload.subject: Re: Hashtag Web3: publisher onboarding and automatic news-feed distribution
payload.text:
Hello NewsBreak Publisher Team,

Thank you - we will proceed through the official channel you referenced.

We did attempt the publisher application earlier; the signup page at https://mp.newsbreak.com/pss/signup requires registration with first name, last name, email and password. We will complete registration and submit the application there.

For the review that follows, our press kit:

- Publisher: Hashtag Web3 - United States organization publishing English-language crypto and Web3 news
- Publication: https://hashtagweb3.com/news
- RSS feed: https://hashtagweb3.com/news/feed.xml (headlines, summaries, original publication dates, canonical links)
- Example native article: https://hashtagweb3.com/bitgetthai
- About: https://hashtagweb3.com/about
- Contact: hi@hashtagweb3.com

Scope note: our news listing also links to external publishers; those external stories are not supplied as our own content. Our workflow uses AI-assisted research and drafting with source and publication checks.

If the registration page needs contact details routed differently (for example a specific contact person), tell us and we will use that.

Thank you,
Hashtag Web3 - hi@hashtagweb3.com
